history.title: History
history.noVersions: This deck has no version. Commit the working list to create the first version.
history.workingListChanged: The working list changed after the last version.
history.workingListSame: The working list did not change after the last version.
history.compareParentLabel: Compare with the parent of version {{number}}
history.compareWorkingLabel: Compare version {{number}} with the working list

changes.noQuantityChanges: The two lists have the same cards and the same quantities.
changes.noPrintingChanges: The two lists use the same printings.

commit.title: Commit the working list
commit.help: A version is a frozen copy of the working list. Write a message that tells what changed.
commit.messageRequired: Write a message for the version.
commit.noChanges: The working list did not change after the last version. Change the deck, then commit.

restore.title: Restore version {{number}}?
restore.help: The working list gets the cards of version {{number}}. Then the application creates a new version. The history keeps all the versions.

revert.title: Revert the merge of version {{number}}?
revert.help: The working list gets the cards that it had before the merge of version {{number}}. Then the application creates a new version. The merge stays in the history.

variants.title: Variants
variants.variantOf: This deck is a variant. Main deck:

createVariant.title: Create a variant
createVariant.name: Name
createVariant.nameHint: For example: Budget, cEDH or Anti-aggro.
createVariant.latestNone: Working list. The application commits it as the first version.

merge.title: Merge into the main deck
merge.help: The working list of the main deck {{main}} gets the cards of the variant {{variant}}. The application creates a merge version in the main deck. You can revert the merge later.
merge.messageHint: You can keep this field empty. The application then writes a message.
merge.done: The application merged the variant into the main deck as version {{number}}.

compare.title: Comparison of two lists
compare.help: Select two lists. A list is the working list of a deck or of a variant, or one of its versions. The comparison shows the changes from the first list to the second list.
compare.noCards: The two lists have no cards.
